declarations.docstring: For every finite group, there are a nonempty index type whose cardinality equals that of its conjugacy classes, nonzero block sizes on that type, and a complex-algebra equivalence from its monoid algebra to the corresponding product of square complex matrix algebras.
The complex monoid algebra of a finite group is algebra-equivalent to a product of nonzero square complex matrix algebras indexed by the finite cardinality of its conjugacy classes.
